name: XmlNamespace
description: Represents a namespace that has been added to a workbook.
remarks: Use the Prefix property to return the prefix of an XmlNamespace object. Use the Uri property to return the Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) of an XmlNamespace object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Uri
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) for the specified XML namespace. Read-only.

properties.name: Prefix
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the prefix for the specified XML namespace. Read-only.
